aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:867.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Description The Information Technology (IT) Support Specialist provides day-to-day technical support for CMN staff and serves as the first point of contact for technology-related issues. This position diagnoses and resolves hardware, software, and device issues while supporting CMN employees both in person and remotely. The IT Support Specialist manages routine IT operations and escalates complex infrastructure, server, network, security, and enterprise system issues to the IT Manager as needed. Primary Job Responsibilities Support all CMN offices with IT-related issues, including desktop and application support in Mac and Windows environments. Diagnose and resolve problems on all types of technology related to hardware, software, mobile devices, printers, and transmission devices/media. Assess the situation, determine next steps, execute action plans, and review to ensure issues have been resolved. Serve as the first point of contact for employee technology support requests and escalate complex infrastructure, server, network, security, and enterprise system issues to the IT Manager as needed. Process paperwork for new hires and employee departures and coordinate account creation, updates, and deactivation across company platforms. Assist with deployment and configuration of laptops, desktops, monitors, and mobile devices for CMN employees. Assist with Microsoft 365 user administration, license assignments, and user support. Support SharePoint access, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and other Microsoft 365 applications. Assist with monitoring Windows Servers, Hyper-V virtual machines, and Synology NAS storage, escalating issues to the IT Manager when appropriate. Support Cisco Spam Filter, Kandji device enrollment, endpoint support, and user security-related requests. Provide first-level support for QuickBooks access and application issues, escalating complex issues as needed. Create users and provision phones within the 3CX phone system. Support office technology including LED Video Systems, HVAC systems, Camera Systems, conference room technology, and printers. Coordinate workstation moves, desktop deployments, application installations, and new office setups. Maintain IT equipment inventory and assist with technology purchasing and asset tracking. Document support requests, resolutions, and recurring issues while following established IT procedures and standards. Requirements High School Diploma or its equivalency (Associate's or Bachelor's Degree preferred) A minimum of 2 years of related work experience Bilingual Spanish (strongly preferred) Experience troubleshooting hardware and software issues on Mac, PC, iPhone, and Microsoft 365 applications Experience supporting printers, mobile devices, conferencing technology, and office peripherals Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills Excellent interpersonal skills for interaction with internal and external staff Ability

Customer & Business Focus: Connects delivery work to customer value, revenue, growth, retention, operational improvements, and strategic outcomes. With companies located across the United States, Crest Industries is committed to bringing together the best people and the right resources to meet today’s challenges and deliver the innovations of tomorrow. With significant recent growth and company acquisitions, Crest more than ever is a catalyst for change, using a little grit and a lot of determination to drive a forward movement for our customers and our employees. Crest Industries is seeking an Enterprise Risk Management Program Analyst (“ERM Program Analyst”) to support the execution, coordination, and continued maturity of Crest’s Enterprise Risk Management program. This role will help maintain the enterprise risk register, coordinate Risk Owner and Risk Liaison updates, support ERM dashboards and reporting, track mitigation actions, and prepare materials for leadership and ERM Steering Committee review. The ERM Program Analyst reports to the Insurance and Risk Manager and will work closely with Risk Owners, Risk Liaisons, business-unit leaders, functional stakeholders, and external ERM advisors. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, analytical, curious, and comfortable working with data, process documentation, cross-functional stakeholders, and recurring reporting cycles. Prior ERM experience is helpful but not required. Relevant experience may include risk management, operations, project coordination, compliance, internal audit, insurance, finance, legal, safety, quality, data analysis, business administration, or process improvement. This role will require the successful candidate to quickly build ERM knowledge, work through ambiguity, and become Crest’s internal owner of the ERM process over time. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: · Support recurring ERM update cycles, including Risk Owner meetings, Risk Liaison communications, data collection, follow-up, and status tracking. Assist with development of key risk indicators, risk metrics, action-plan reporting, and other reporting enhancements as the ERM program matures. · Support development and maintenance of ERM tools, templates, process documentation, guidance materials, and training resources. Maintain Power BI inputs and support recurring dashboard updates, data validation, trend analysis, and risk reporting. · Own the recurring ERM program calendar, including risk update cycles, Risk Owner meetings, Risk Liaison coordination, Steering Committee preparation, action-item tracking, and follow-up reporting. Promote practical risk ownership by helping teams understand ERM expectations, timelines, and documentation requirements. · Identify opportunities to improve the ERM process, reduce administrative burden, clarify expectations, and improve consistency across business units. Escalate process gaps, incomplete updates, inconsistent information, or items requiring leadership attention. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:f94d6945-55d.title: Field & Events Marketer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:f94d6945-55d.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. If you’re driven by challenge and eager to make a significant impact in a high-caliber role, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. We're hiring a Field & Events Marketer to own our presence at industry events, tradeshows, and conferences across North America. You'll source the right shows, run them end to end, and be the person on the ground making sure every event drives real pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone 1-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:07b8f143-15a5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Operations Supervisor based in Switzerland. This is a remote operations leadership role focused on scaling and maintaining a high-performing distributed workforce. You will work closely with the Operations Manager to translate broader objectives into effective day-to-day execution. Your focus will include workforce planning, attendance, quality assurance, coaching, onboarding, and operational administration. You will help grow the operation toward a target of 100 active agents while maintaining consistent performance and reliability. Track operational performance, identify gaps, and take appropriate corrective action to maintain productivity, quality, and workforce stability. Strong ability to manage distributed or remote teams while maintaining accountability for attendance, productivity, and quality. Experience monitoring performance against defined standards and providing constructive coaching when issues arise. Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accurate rosters, schedules, documentation, and operational records. Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, operational tracking systems, and basic financial or invoicing information. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies, follow established procedures, and maintain accurate records. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with agents, managers, and clients. Proactive and hands-on approach to problem-solving, with the ability to respond quickly to operational issues. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with operational leadership. Results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on team growth, quality, attendance, and consistent execution. Benefits Base salary: $200 per month. jobgether-jobgether:lever:1afaee05-f1ac-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst based in United States. This is a remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced finance professional to support enterprise-level financial planning and decision-making. You will analyze financial and business performance across income, expenses, budgets, forecasts, and operational results. The role offers the opportunity to turn complex financial data into actionable recommendations that influence strategic direction. You will identify trends, investigate variances, and help leaders understand cost impacts and performance opportunities. Working across multiple stakeholders, you will contribute to budgeting, forecasting, process improvements, and financial controls. The position suits an analytical, organized, and independent professional who can navigate complex business environments with confidence. You will play an important role in improving financial visibility, operational efficiency, and informed business decisions. Conduct complex financial analysis covering company expenses, income, earnings, and other business results across historical, current, and projected operations. Research and analyze corporate-level financial and business information, translating findings into recommendations that support strategic planning and enterprise decision-making. Analyze fluctuations and variances in financial and business performance, including actual results versus budgets, and identify trends, cost impacts, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Support the preparation of annual budgets, financial forecasts, and business plans by providing accurate analysis and relevant financial insights. Monitor departmental expenses, identify spending trends, and recommend actions that support effective cost control and resource utilization. Prepare financial reports covering income, expenses, earnings, and overall financial position to support management decision-making. Interpret financial reports, statistics, and operational data for management, clearly communicating implications and recommendations. Recommend improvements to accounting systems, financial processes, and planning practices to increase efficiency and strengthen resource management. Stay current with developments in financial planning and control and recommend effective practices, systems, and process enhancements. Support performance evaluation activities by contributing financial insight, coaching, and constructive feedback where appropriate. Navigate complex organizational situations and collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders while exercising sound judgment and discretion. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Approximately 6 years of relevant financial analysis experience, with demonstrated capability in complex financial and business analysis. Experience conducting cost-benefit analyses, alternative analyses, variance analysis, forecasting, and other forms of financial evaluation. Strong knowledge of financial and operational planning processes, principles, and best practices. Advanced analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong business judgment and the ability to make balanced, well-informed decisions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:53b02639-9b58-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Revenue Operations based in the United States. This is a senior opportunity to build and lead a modern Revenue Operations function within a growing B2B SaaS organization. You will own the full GTM operations architecture across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, from Salesforce architecture to forecasting and deal governance. You will establish scalable systems, clean data foundations, and processes that give teams confidence in their revenue decisions. You will also build new capabilities such as Deal Desk, compensation planning, and AI-driven automation. With significant autonomy and executive visibility, you will shape how the organization scales its revenue engine. This is an ideal role for an experienced operator who enjoys building structure in an ambitious, evolving environment. Own the overall Revenue Operations strategy and define a cohesive operating model across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Assess, redesign, and strengthen the Salesforce architecture, ensuring clean data, consistent definitions, reliable reporting, and a trusted source of truth across the GTM organization. Take ownership of the broader GTM technology ecosystem, including vendor selection, contracts, budgets, integrations, consolidation, and ongoing optimization. Establish and manage revenue data integrity across systems, ensuring records, business definitions, attribution, and reporting remain accurate and consistent. Build the Deal Desk function from the ground up, including pricing approvals, quote-to-close workflows, non-standard deal governance, and appropriate commercial guardrails. Own Marketing Operations infrastructure, including lead capture, enrichment, routing, nurturing, attribution, and the measurement of marketing-generated pipeline. Design and model sales and SDR compensation plans in partnership with Finance, ensuring plans support business objectives and are clearly documented. Develop and own forecasting methodology, tooling, reporting cadence, and operating rhythms that provide reliable visibility to sales leadership and executive stakeholders. Lead annual GTM planning, including territory design, capacity planning, quota setting, and alignment with Sales leadership and Finance. Codify and enforce core GTM processes, including lead routing, sourcing attribution, opportunity stages, qualification definitions, and forecasting standards. Manage and develop the existing Business Systems team member, hire a planned GTM Engineer, and build the broader Revenue Operations organization as the business scales. Drive automation and AI-enabled workflows across the GTM stack to improve efficiency, data quality, reporting, and operational scalability. Establish measurable first-year outcomes, including a unified data model, functioning Deal Desk, standardized lead processes, reliable forecasting, and documented compensation plans. Serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership, providing clear analysis, revenue insights, and recommendations that support growth and operational decision-making. Requirements 6+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations within B2B SaaS, including at least 2 years leading a function or significant operational area. Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise, with demonstrated success improving an inherited Salesforce environment, including its architecture, data quality, workflows, and reporting. Experience owning the architecture connecting CRM and marketing automation platforms and creating an integrated GTM technology environment. Familiarity with platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Clay, Common Room, Nooks, and Gong, or comparable GTM technologies. Proven experience establishing new operational functions such as Deal Desk, Marketing Operations, or Customer Succes

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7f6c9f44-3a99-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Developer (Flutter) based in Spain. This is a high-impact opportunity to own the mobile experience of a digital retail ecosystem used in demanding, real-world store environments. You’ll build a high-performance mobile application connecting directly with payment terminals, printers, barcode scanners, and other specialized hardware. The role goes beyond conventional app development, combining Flutter with native Android/iOS capabilities through an Add-to-App architecture. You’ll help deliver critical features spanning point-of-sale, billing, inventory, banking, B2B commerce, and AI-powered user assistance. A strong focus on offline-first architecture, reliability, speed, and seamless checkout experiences makes this a technically challenging role. You’ll work closely with Product and Backend teams in a fully remote, international environment where autonomy and ownership are highly valued. It’s an excellent fit for an experienced Flutter developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building products with tangible everyday impact. Own and develop the mobile experience for a mission-critical digital retail platform used in fast-paced store environments. Build and maintain Flutter modules using an Add-to-App architecture, enabling seamless communication between Dart and native Android/iOS SDKs. Develop native integrations with payment terminals, receipt printers, barcode scanners, and other retail hardware. Integrate mobile functionality with Java-based backend microservices through REST APIs. Develop and maintain features across point-of-sale sales and billing, B2B marketplace, banking, inventory management, and AI-powered assistance. Create high-quality, pixel-accurate interfaces from Figma designs, optimized for rapid interaction and busy retail environments. Design and implement robust offline-first capabilities using local storage technologies such as SQLite. Optimize application performance to deliver fast, responsive, reliable, and crash-resistant experiences. Develop and maintain integration tests, particularly for hardware-sensitive and transaction-critical workflows. Establish mobile development best practices, participate in code reviews, and maintain high standards across the codebase.
